indices.name: Yahoo Finance
indices.note: Checked 2026-09-23. Stooq's public CSV returned 404 or a browser check, so it is not the board. This chart endpoint returned index prices with no login and no API key. Rows stay marked delayed. On 2026-09-24 the same endpoint returned FTSE 100, DAX, Nikkei 225, and Hang Seng. On 2026-09-25 it returned Russell 2000, CBOE VIX, CAC 40, Euro Stoxx 50, S&P/TSX, ASX 200, KOSPI, Shanghai Composite as 000001.SS, BSE Sensex, and Ibovespa. ^SSEC returned 404 and is not used.

On 2026-09-25 it returned the New Zealand dollar, krona, yuan, Hong Kong dollar, Singapore dollar, rupee, won, Mexican peso, real, rand, euro/sterling, and euro/yen.
